Elli is all about empowering and simplifying your e-mobility. Use the Elli app to find charging stations across Europe and to manage charging at home. Simply register with Elli, choose a charging tariff that fits you, and then you can use your Elli Card or App to easily charge just about anywhere.

Here's how Elli empowers you:

▸ Europe's largest charging network

▸ Charge your way
Charge via the app, with your Elli Card, or via Plug & Charge.

▸ Simplified pricing
Choose from three tariffs to fit your charging needs. You get affordable, transparent, and one fixed price for any charging partner you use.

▸ Easy station search, filtering, and navigation
Filter your station search by availability, charging speed, and outlet type. Then easily navigate to the charger of your choice.

▸ Plan charging into your route
Find the best charging stops during your trip with the EV trip planner.

▸ Manage your Wallbox remotely
You can easily access and manage your home Wallbox from anywhere directly in the App.

Monitor your charging progress right from your home screen! The Elli widget quickly displays your Wallbox status or last charging session results. Easily stay on top of your charging when you’re on the go.

View graphs and data from your charging history. Download invoices or records for all of your charging sessions.

Help us improve by giving feedback! We'll also help you out with any questions or issues at support@elli.eco.
